source.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original tall portrait environmental photograph, approximately 1024 × 2048, for an editable messaging scene.
Primary request: a luxurious but believable airplane window seat at the gate, seen from the seated passenger. A close-up of the seatback's large portrait-oriented entertainment display dominates the view, with a narrow view of the oval cabin window and airport terminal beyond at the right edge. A small snack-cart corner and one restrained paper cup sit near the lower-left edge, a folded tray table and real seat controls below.
Composition: nearly straight-on to the seatback display, not a diagonal angle. The integrated glass display fills roughly x6–94% and y10–76% of the tall photograph. It is physically set into premium charcoal and warm-gray seat trim, with a thin realistic bezel, not a free-floating tablet. Show a calm dim image of clouds at blue hour on the display with very low contrast and subtle reflections, so a live text thread can later remain readable over it. Keep everything below the display compact in the bottom22%; include a horizontal dark control ledge immediately beneath it and a clean tray-table surface across the bottom. The partial airplane window clearly shows a terminal gate, aircraft wing and airport sign outside; no close people.
Lighting and materials: real cabin photography, soft warm reading lights, cool airport-blue evening light, fine upholstery grain, matte molded trim, believable screen reflections and brushed-metal tray hardware.
Critical constraints: no phone bezel, app interface, chat messages, message bubbles, fake giant labeled buttons, icons, commercial logos, advertising copy or watermark. Do not put words on the large display. Avoid a science-fiction cabin. This is one coherent photographic scene; the eventual message thread and all controls will be live editable UI.
